trust_decision.summary: The per-tensor ttype read from an untrusted model file is used as an index into ggml's type_traits table (ggml_type_size) without a range check; the fix rejects ttype outside [0, GGML_TYPE_COUNT) in each model-file tensor loader.

landing_point.why: The summary names whisper_model_load; the ttype-to-ggml_type_size call in its weight-loading loop is the obvious OOB read.

fix_sites.module_kind: core library, Whisper ASR model loader
core library, VAD (Silero) model loader in the same file, far from the ASR loader
second implementation: separate Parakeet model family with its own loader and public header (include/parakeet.h:89)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/parakeet.cpp:1479 (Parakeet loader, separate model family and header); also the VAD loader at src/whisper.cpp:5208

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names whisper_model_load for Whisper ASR models; Parakeet is a different model family with its own API, VAD is an optional auxiliary model, and the quantize tool in examples/ is an offline developer utility, not the library.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Quantized and BF16 model files carry legitimate non-F32/F16 ttype values (written by the quantize tool); an over-broad whitelist such as ttype in {F32,F16}, or ttype == wtype, would reject valid quantized models, and conv tensors legitimately use vtype not wtype.

O7_producer.where: examples/common-ggml.cpp:163-173 (quantize tool writes ttype into the model file)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Quantize tools read per-tensor ttype from the input model file and pass it unchecked to ggml_type_name, which indexes type_traits.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is in examples/, an offline CLI developer tool (whisper-quantize / parakeet-quantize), not the library's model loader the advisory names.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different directory and build target from src/; reached via examples/quantize/quantize.cpp:168 and examples/parakeet-quantize/parakeet-quantize.cpp:182

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A loader path mapping a file-supplied type id to ggml_type through a helper table without a range check, e.g. a per-tensor override type for KV-cache or alignment heads.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The hparams ftype path already maps a file value to a ggml_type; a maintainer adding a per-tensor variant could copy the cast-and-use idiom at src/whisper.cpp:1932.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A derived size computation (ggml_row_size or ggml_blck_size on the file ttype rather than tensor->type) in a buffer-to-device copy path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The neighbouring check uses ggml_blck_size(tensor->type); a refactor computing read size from the file type is a plausible small change.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds read via unchecked enum index from untrusted file (CWE-125/CWE-119)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C++17 compiler (clang/gcc); CPU backend sufficient
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test-whisper-buffer-loader.cpp, tests/test-vad.cpp, tests/test-parakeet.cpp exercise loaders but need real model files; no malformed-model tests at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the ttype range check only in whisper_model_load (src/whisper.cpp:1932), missing the VAD and Parakeet loaders and the quantize tool.

out_of_scope_notes: examples/common-ggml.cpp:112-117 has no n_dims bound before writing ne[4] (the library loaders check n_dims; separate field).
examples/quantize/quantize.cpp:142-151 writes word[len] with an unchecked uint32 len into char word[129] (vocab field, separate).
Tensor name length (src/whisper.cpp:1908, src/whisper.cpp:5184, src/parakeet.cpp:1455) is unchecked (negative or zero length); separate field.
ggml_ftype_to_ggml_type aborts via GGML_ASSERT on unknown ftype (ggml/src/ggml.c:1461), so the COUNT check at src/whisper.cpp:1568 is unreachable for bad values.
unverified: j_defence_ineffective=1 rests on ggml's bound checks being plain assert() (ggml/src/ggml.c:1333-1337, 1352-1356), which are compiled out under NDEBUG in Release builds; I did not confirm the build flags.

How-type room is thin: every site is the same one-line range check on the same field (WHERE-type siblings that tend to fall together); the only distance lever is the examples/ quantize route and the Parakeet second implementation.
